Clean recipe data. Return ONLY valid JSON matching RecipeDraft schema.

Rules:
- Separate ingredients: 'salt and pepper' = 2 entries
- Extract units from names: '1 cup flour' → quantity:'1', unit:'cup', name:'flour'
- Put prep notes in 'notes' field
- Add description if missing (1-2 sentences based on title/ingredients)
- Preserve all valid data, only clean formatting
